priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Flametongue Weapon, and Thunderstrike Ward at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper pre-combat or when Ascendance is not active (cooldown > 10s).
Use Ascendance if Stormkeeper has more than 15 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Voltaic Blaze or Flame Shock if Master of the Elements is not active and the DoT needs refreshing.
Cast Tempest if you have the Master of the Elements buff or have reached 2 stacks of the Tempest buff.
Cast Earthquake as your primary Maelstrom spender against 3 or more targets.
Cast Elemental Blast as a spender on 3 targets if they do not all have Lightning Rod applied.
Use Lava Burst if Purging Flames is active or to consume Lava Surge procs to trigger Master of the Elements.
Cast Stormkeeper-empowered Chain Lightning as long as it will not overcap your Maelstrom.
Cast Tempest whenever it becomes available.
Use Chain Lightning as your primary filler to generate Maelstrom.
Use Spiritwalker's Grace if you need to cast while moving for more than 6 yards.
On the move, prioritize casting Voltaic Blaze, Flame Shock, or Frost Shock.
Use offensive racial abilities (Berserking, Blood Fury, etc.) and trinkets alongside Ascendance.
